title: scrumia-issues — ScrumIA
meta_description: scrumia-issues: an experimental Claude Code mod — the tickets a session mentions, whether it took each into account, their status and what remains.
tagline: Which tickets did this session touch, and where does each stand?
responsibilities: An experimental Claude Code mod, made of hooks rather than skills. It keeps, as the session goes, one row per ticket: whether the session worked on it, its board status, and what the agent says remains to do. Tickets typed in a prompt or named in the agent's final text are listed at once as not assessed; /issues opens the pane.
refusals: It refuses a status without its reason: what remains must be written, nothing when done. It refuses a status that is not a column of the tracker, never reads a prompt the person did not type, and never mixes the tables of two sessions.
philosophy: Assumes the status is what the agent reports, not what the board says. Costs trust in that report: the mod does not read the board, so it cannot tell a stale status from a right one.
